name: iam-policy-scan
description: Reads whole IAM, RBAC and role documents, not lines: JSON, YAML, CloudFormation, Terraform (documents, jsonencode, heredocs), ARM, Bicep, Kubernetes. Refuses Allow with Action star or an inverted key, public or any-principal trust, cluster-admin bindings, subscription Owner. Asks for service wildcards on a named resource and cross-account trust. Only added grants. Misses computed grants and templated YAML that will not parse. Waiver: pragma, or .chock/iam-policy-scan.json for JSON.
